brief.summary_1line: Sugriva confronts the titan Virupaksha in fierce combat, defeats him after a brutal exchange, and restores courage to the monkey army.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sugriva leaps forward and smashes the head of Virupaksha’s elephant with a massive tree, causing the great beast to collapse screaming.
Virupaksha, sword drawn and armored in bull hide, charges on foot toward Sugriva as the battlefield rages with monkeys and titans clashing around them.
Sugriva strikes Virupaksha on the temple like a thunderbolt, sending the blood-covered titan crashing to the ground before the roaring armies.
